overview: The committee voted to recommend the FY24 budget and state match projections to the City Council. Members also discussed upcoming meeting schedules, summer outreach events, and plans for a five-year anniversary celebration of the Community Preservation Act in Medford.

items.title: Annual Plan Review
items.summary: The committee tabled the review of the annual plan because the document was not yet ready for presentation.

items.title: Meeting Format Discussion
items.summary: Members discussed returning to in-person or hybrid meetings to improve collaboration and avoid the technical issues experienced with remote participation.

items.title: FY24 Budget Allocation Recommendation
items.summary: The committee approved a recommendation to the City Council for the FY24 budget using a conservative 22.5% state match estimate and minimum 10% allocations for affordable housing, historic preservation, and open space.

items.title: 2023 Calendar and Application Process
items.summary: The committee reviewed the 2023 meeting calendar and discussed streamlining the upcoming application cycle by potentially removing eligibility determination forms.

items.title: Summer Outreach and Five-Year Celebration
items.summary: Members planned participation in the June Circle the Square event and brainstormed ideas for a community celebration in September to mark the fifth year of the program.

items.title: Committee Membership Update
items.summary: The committee discussed recent reappointments and the status of vacancies for representatives from various city boards.
